name: Qiyana
notes: Qiyana spawns holding the default Rock (Terrain) element from her respawn behavior; the dummy arena has no brush/river/terrain, so this is the only element she can ever hold.

The opening cast is Elemental Wrath (Q), which consumes that Rock element; since the target starts at full health, the Terrain bonus (extra damage below 50% max health, which only applies to this first enchanted cast) never triggers, so every Q cast in the fight deals the identical base + 90% bonus AD physical hit.

While the element is still held (until that first Q lands), Terrashape's passive bonus attack speed and bonus on-hit magic damage apply to attacks and to Q/E; the moment the first Q consumes the element it is gone for the rest of the fight and never returns, since nothing in the arena lets her regather it.
Terrashape (W) is never actively cast: Qiyana already holds the element at t=0 and there is nothing left to gather afterward, so the active itself never contributes damage.
Edge of Ixtal / Elemental Wrath's reduced damage against targets beyond the first is not modeled, since the fight is a single target.

Audacity (E) is cast on cooldown; the dash is assumed to always connect (the stationary dummy is always within the 250-unit arrival check) and its damage lands instantly, the same simplification used for Jax's Leap Strike. Landing also auto-orders an attack, modeled as an attack-timer reset.

Supreme Display of Talent (R) is cast on cooldown, its damage landing 0.25s after cast (its cast time); its entire payload is structurally gated by a shockwave that needs river/brush/terrain geometry, which the dummy arena lacks, but since the dossier's damage formula is well-defined and a damage source is required, R is assumed to always find terrain to trigger its shockwave (the most common in-game reading where such geometry is nearly always present on Summoner's Rift) and deals its full physical damage plus 10% of the target's maximum health.

Royal Privilege and Terrashape's on-hit magic damage are read as applying only to basic attacks and Q/E ("basic abilities"), not to the ultimate R, matching the common reading that "basic abilities" excludes the ultimate.
Royal Privilege's per-target internal cooldown is read from the numbers sheet's ICD field (14s) rather than the wiki template's static value (25s), since the sheet reflects the live game data.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: R's damage is delivered entirely by a shockwave that requires nearby river/brush/terrain geometry; the terrain-less dummy arena would otherwise make it always deal zero, so it is assumed to always find terrain, matching the common in-game case.
